scientific_limitations: Only rotation-invariant orthogonal projection of the specified uniform pentagonal antiprism is classified; nongeneric normal directions have measure zero.
The six-great-circle chamber enumeration and its exact number-field sign tests are finite and exhaustive under proved normal-fan geometry; numerical hull tests are supplementary.
The previously known mean silhouette complexity is not claimed as new; the full three-point probability distribution and normal-chamber incidence classification are the specific contribution.
The complete 1997 Kettner-Welzl article could not be inspected; priority outside indexed full texts remains uncertain.
title: Exact Haar shadow polygon law for the uniform pentagonal antiprism
